senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; דלי) [suspended,] branches of the vine trained to an espalier &c.; also grapes of the espalier.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:1">Peah IV, 1</cite> <he>במחובר לקרקע ובד׳ וכ׳</he> of that which is directly connected with the ground as well as of the hanging fruits (grapes) and of the palm tree; <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 3:16">Tosef. ib. III, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 10:4:2">Y. B. Mets. X, 12ᶜ</cite> <he>ד׳ אחת וכ׳</he> a grape vine which was overhanging a neighbor’s peach tree; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דָּלִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:6">Men. VIII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 86b">86ᵇ</cite>) wine for libation must not be offered <he>מן הד׳</he> (Tosef. ib. IX, 10 sing.) from grapes of the espalier, opp. <cite ref="T00210"><he>רגליות</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 53a:3">Pes. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ של וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:15">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 15</cite> <he>ד׳ שבאשכול וכ׳</he> the hanging grapes of Abel.
